children: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. (NASDAQ:AVXL) faces investor pressure to replace its board and hire an experienced CEO as it shifts resources to advance blarcamesine into Phase 2b/3 for Alzheimer’s, Rett and Fragile X, seeks FDA guidance on pediatric Rett enrollment, and will discuss strategy on a Sept 9 investor call.
Replace Anavex Life Sciences Corp. Board
: Investor PVG urged replacing Anavex Life Sciences (AVXL) board and hiring an experienced CEO, saying current leadership can’t secure funding needed to advance blarcamesine into Phase 2b/3.
: Anavex (AVXL) is prioritizing blarcamesine development for Alzheimer’s, Rett and Fragile X syndromes, pausing non-core programs and reallocating resources to those clinical programs.
FDA Meeting On Pediatric Rett Trial
: Anavex (AVXL): FDA granted a meeting to discuss adding pediatric patients to the U.S. Phase 3 trial of ANAVEX 2-73 for Rett syndrome, addressing the protocol change for U.S. enrollment.
: Anavex Life Sciences (AVXL) will hold an investor call Sept 9, 2026 at 4:00 PM ET. Interim CEO Terrie Kellmeyer will review the company’s clinical development strategy; dial-in and replay via IR.
